top_signals.title: China Repo Push Advances as Legal Issues, Low Yields Drag
top_signals.summary: China’s effort to help global investors borrow against their 3.2 trillion yuan ($477 billion) in domestic bond holdings is gaining traction, even as legal friction and low yields limit broader participation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Capitec Profit, Dividend Hit Record as Clients Top 26.6 Million
top_signals.summary: Capitec Bank Holdings Ltd.’s first-half profit and interim dividend jumped to a fresh record as higher fee and commission income at South Africa’s biggest bank by clients lifted revenue.

top_signals.title: Proposals on reforming Prime Minister’s Office focus on leader’s time management
top_signals.summary: An LDP official cited the report, which compared Japan's system with other countries, to argue Japan's parliament demands more of its leader's time.
